subject.title: [Bug]: Scheduled isolated agentTurn outer run records error although session ended success

question: Should successful isolated cron execution followed by post-run delivery failure persist as status=ok with deliveryStatus=not-delivered, or wait for a first-class warning/degraded cron status?
rationale: The choice affects persisted run status, retry/backoff counters, failure alerts, Control UI/API semantics, and external tooling that may read cron status.

options.title: Land narrow status split
options.body: Accept status=ok plus deliveryStatus=not-delivered for this delivery-failure path and land the focused finalizer fix after review.

options.title: Use warning/degraded status
options.body: Route this through the broader warning-status contract so execution success plus failed delivery has its own primary run state.

options.title: Keep error semantics
options.body: Continue treating delivery failures as primary cron errors, accepting the misleading successful-session status mismatch.

recommendation.title: Land narrow status split
recommendation.body: Accept status=ok plus deliveryStatus=not-delivered for this delivery-failure path and land the focused finalizer fix after review.

likelyOwner.reason: Current history points to recent ownership of the finalizer and scheduler status surfaces affected by this decision.
